Sampled sign changes only: tangencies and multiple crossings can be missed. No detections do not prove absence; failed and unresolved draws are not event-free. Numerical brackets exclude integration and physical uncertainty. Simultaneous geometric distance under adopted forces is not apparent occultation or continuous collision detection. All draws share the backend 20-second context and 250000 force calls. No event probabilities or independent accuracy claim. Only one draw is expanded at a time; export retains every draw and full diagnostics.

Conditional first-detected timing · descriptive supplied-draw statistics, not event probabilities or confidence intervals. Earlier unclassified zeros exclude a draw. Different draws need not describe the same physical event. Bracket bounds exclude integration and physical errors; two selected draws do not establish adequate tail sampling. Export retains all selected/excluded identities.
